name: carc
description: Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (CARC) used in 835 CAS segments. Curated common subset.
source: X12 / Washington Publishing Company Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (public)

codes.4: The procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used.
codes.5: The procedure code/type of bill is inconsistent with the place of service.
codes.6: The procedure/revenue code is inconsistent with the patient's age.
codes.7: The procedure/revenue code is inconsistent with the patient's gender.
codes.8: The procedure code is inconsistent with the provider type/specialty.
codes.9: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the patient's age.
codes.10: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the patient's gender.
codes.11: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the procedure.
codes.12: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the provider type.
codes.13: The date of death precedes the date of service.
codes.14: The date of birth follows the date of service.
codes.15: The authorization number is missing, invalid, or does not apply.
codes.16: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s).
codes.19: This is a work-related injury/illness and thus the liability of the Worker's Compensation Carrier.
codes.20: This injury/illness is covered by the liability carrier.
codes.21: This injury/illness is the liability of the no-fault carrier.
codes.22: This care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits.
codes.23: The impact of prior payer(s) adjudication including payments and/or adjustments.
codes.24: Charges are covered under a capitation agreement/managed care plan.
codes.29: The time limit for filing has expired.
codes.31: Patient cannot be identified as our insured.
codes.39: Services denied at the time authorization/pre-certification was requested.
codes.40: Charges do not meet qualifications for emergent/urgent care.
codes.45: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.
codes.50: These are non-covered services because this is not deemed a 'medical necessity' by the payer.
codes.54: Multiple physicians/assistants are not covered in this case.
codes.55: Procedure/treatment/drug is deemed experimental/investigational by the payer.
codes.58: Treatment was deemed by the payer to have been rendered in an inappropriate or invalid place of service.
codes.59: Processed based on multiple or concurrent procedure rules.
codes.97: The benefit for this service is included in the payment/allowance for another service that has already been adjudicated.
codes.109: Claim/service not covered by this payer/contractor. Send the claim to the correct payer.
codes.119: Benefit maximum for this time period or occurrence has been reached.
codes.151: Payer deems the information submitted does not support this many/frequency of services.
codes.181: Procedure code was invalid on the date of service.
codes.182: Procedure modifier was invalid on the date of service.
codes.204: This service/equipment/drug is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
codes.B7: This provider was not certified/eligible to be paid for this procedure/service on this date of service.
codes.B13: Previously paid. Payment for this claim/service may have been provided in a previous payment.
codes.B15: This service/procedure requires that a qualifying service/procedure be received and covered.
